description:
Parent / split ticket. v2.0.0 release umbrella. The release-gate contract is locked in N-008 §24 (consumed verbatim). T-010 itself is too broad to execute in one pass; it is split into five child tickets that map cleanly onto the §24 checklist:

- T-010a — Runner harness. Repo-local runner that drives the v2 helper over JSON-RPC, executes scripted-local rows, applies the ffprobe/mediainfo recipes from N-008 §20, collects the evidence bundle per N-008 §7, and emits a per-row pass/fail report. First milestone: the 18-row smoke suite (N-008 §22) on M1.
- T-010b — Synthetic asset creation. Produce the L-* loads from N-008 §5 (binaries, scripts, operator notes). Excludes L-AUDIO-SYNC (audio milestone).
- T-010c — RC execution and report. Run the smoke suite on M1 and the RC suite on M1+M2+M3+M4 per N-008 §23. Produce the v1.1.0 vs v2.0.0 comparison plot (§21). Collect evidence bundles. Mark every must-pass cell of the §18 coverage gate green or red. Output is the release-gate verdict against §24 items 1–7. Blocked by T-010a + T-010b.
- T-010d — Packaging audit. Confirm electron-builder produces expected artifacts (AppImage, .deb for Linux; Portable.exe, Setup.exe for Windows placeholder per N-008 §4). Every shipped artifact has a matching .sha256 sidecar (global rule). Helper binary ships via extraResources with its own .sha256 sidecar (N-007 §17). VAL-UI-010 (sha256 mismatch refuses boot) and VAL-UI-014 (dependency probe modal) green. Linux .deb Depends honoured: pipewire (>= 0.3.x), xdg-desktop-portal (>= 1.18). RELEASES.md updated with v2.0.0 entry. Output is the release-gate verdict against §24 items 8–9.
- T-010e — Release publish. Bump package.json version. Update CHANGELOG / release notes capturing the architectural shift away from MediaRecorder. Mark Issues #1 and #3 resolved; confirm Issues #2 and #4 addressed (either by v1.1.1 or absorbed into v2). User explicitly approves before tag/push/publish. No commits, tags, or publishes without explicit user request. Blocked by T-010c + T-010d.

Dependency graph: T-010a and T-010b run in parallel and unblock T-010c. T-010d runs in parallel with T-010a/b/c. T-010e is blocked by T-010c and T-010d.

T-010 itself does no execution. It is the umbrella that closes when all five children close. §24 items 10 (release notes generated from matrix output) and the GA cut itself happen in T-010e.

Out of scope (inherited from N-008 §25): no test files in this ticket, no CI changes, no Windows hardware in matrix (W1 placeholder), no audio gating, no 4K60 success claim (acceptance plan only — execution may produce a red signal that becomes a tracked post-GA issue per N-008 §24 footnote).
title: v2.0.0 release umbrella (split into T-010a..e)
